Autopay

Tenants set up, change and cancel autopay themselves. Staff cannot start or change it. You can only pause one for safety, and the tenant is emailed at once. Every step is kept in a permanent log that can be checked for tampering.

Autopay is off for everyone. Nobody can set it up until the setting autopay_enabled is switched to on.
